list.title: Guides & partners
list.description: Local guides and village partners who host departures. Link an account so they can open the partner portal.

empty.title: No guides yet
empty.description: Add your first guide or village partner.

sections.profileHint: Name and contact details the team uses to reach the guide.
sections.workHint: Used to suggest guides when assigning departures.
sections.internalHint: Visible to the team only, never to the guide.

fields.name: Name
fields.phoneHint: E.g. 0812 3456 7890 or +31 20 123 4567. Stored in international format.
fields.destinationsHint: Pick the destinations this guide usually works in.
fields.activeHint: Inactive guides cannot be assigned and see no departures in the partner portal.

account.title: Partner portal account
account.description: The linked account can sign in to the partner portal and sees only departures assigned to this guide.
account.adminOnly: Only admins can link portal accounts.
account.emailHint: The partner must sign up first. Their role becomes Partner.
account.linked: Account linked. The partner needs to sign in again.
account.unlinked: Account unlinked and returned to traveller.
account.unlinkConfirm: Unlink {email} from this guide? The account goes back to traveller and is signed out everywhere.
